snippet.title: Super SpongeBob 2 - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🧽 Be There AND Be Square! 🧽

Super SpongeBob 2 is a 2D platformer fangame in the style of 8-Bit NES Hummer Team Bootlegs.

This title is loosely based on older SpongeBob games along with SpongeBob episodes (Seasons 1-4 with hints of the newer Seasons). Most of the musical melodies are from the show and early SpongeBob games with original tracks/arrangements made just for this game.

Be ready to jump over gaps, blow bubbles, and gather Golden Spatulas in this NES styled SpongeBob SquarePants fangame!

This game can and will throw challenges at you, don't expect a completely easy journey as SSB2 is designed to be a harder experience compared to other SpongeBob games.

🧽 Be There AND Be Square! 🧽

(Title screen footage & audio belong to Nickelodeon, I don't own that and I don't claim to own it)


Updates will still be made to fix any bugs within the game, so don't forget to check the pages!

GameJolt page: https://gamejolt.com/games/SuperSpongeBob2/814964

Itch.io page: https://lood-man.itch.io/super-spongebob-2

And be sure to take a listen to the game's OST: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLyDIbayeBL9Be-2QBb4SdnVlQIWMRAKbf
